message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly **≈ 550 kcal** (about 560–580 kcal depending on regional recipe tweaks).  
In terms of macronutrients this translates to:

| Nutrient | Approximate amount |
|----------|--------------------|
| Calories | 540‑590 kcal |
| Total Fat | 28 g |
| Saturated Fat | 10 g |
| Cholesterol | 80 mg |
| Sodium | 950‑1,100 mg |
| Carbohydrates | 45 g |
| Sugars | 9 g |
| Protein | 25 g |

These figures come from U.S. nutrition labels and may vary slightly by country due to ingredient differences or portion sizes. If you’re tracking macros closely, double-check your local menu or use the official McDonald’s app/website for region‑specific data.
